name: imresize
expr: rb = imresize(A,2,'bilinear'); rc = imresize(A,2,'bicubic'); d = imresize(x,[1 3]);
comment: Sig: r = imresize(A, scale_or_[h w], method). Interpolation now matches MATLAB: pixel-centre coordinate map (u = x/scale + 0.5*(1-1/scale)), mirror (symmetric) boundary, antialiasing kernel on shrink (h scaled by the reduction factor). 'bilinear' = triangle, 'bicubic' = Keys a=-0.5, default method = bicubic. Fixes bugs/image/imresize-interp (was wrong corners/grid on upscale + no antialias on downscale: bilinear (1,1) was 0.5625, bicubic 0.5625). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: bilinear x2 [[1 1.25 ...]], bicubic x2 (1,1)=0.71875, downscale [1 2 3 4 5 6]->[1 3] = [1.44922 3.5 5.55078].
